# IIR-0: constexpr half-band coefficients against mpmath (generated by python/constexpr_accuracy.py)

Largest error per design in ulps of each coefficient, against the same formulas at 60 digits. `constexpr`: GCC 13 and Clang 18 (bit-identical, constexpr/expected_bits.txt), with the cancellation-free e. `libm, stable e`: the same steps through numpy's libm. `libm, prototype e`: libm with the prototype's e, which cancels when the transition is wide (the relaxed designs).
